notes.title: Ranking fixed
notes.notes:
So, it seems there was a good reason for not having a single new hi-score entry in almost a month: the ranking server was updated weeks ago, and score transfer had just stopped working.

Problem is fixed now, and the game should have no problem contacting Earth again.

notes.title: Keyboard support: game controller not required anymore
notes.notes:
Sorry for taking so long to add such an essential functionality.

Problem is, it took me some time to realize many players didn't have (or simply didn't want to use) a Xbox-compatible controller to play the game. So, here it is:

[b]WASD or arrow keys:[/b] movement / menu navigation

[b]Spacebar:[/b] fire / OK

[b]M or ESC:[/b] boost / Cancel

[b]< and >:[/b] change weapon
